  Description:
    This scheme provides financial assistance to landless beneficiaries for purchasing residential land, ensuring housing for the underprivileged in rural Bihar.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  --- [Sub-Schema 127] ---
  Title: Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana
  Link:  https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/mmvenay
  Description:
    The "Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial grants for the construction of houses to economically weak widows and single women.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  --- [Sub-Schema 128] ---
  Title: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
  Link:  https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/fchdnnasnc
  Description:
    The "Free Caste Hostel" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides a scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys and ₹1,270 per month for girls for 10 months.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  --- [Sub-Schema 129] ---
  Title: Palanhaar Yojana
  Link:  https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pyr
  Description:
    The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and financial assistance to children aged 0 to 18 years requiring special care and supervision in Rajasthan. It ensures their upbringing, education, and overall development through recognized guardians called “Palanhaar”.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  --- [Sub-Schema 130] ---
  Title: Gitanjali Housing Scheme
  Link:  https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/gitanjali-housing
  Description:
    The scheme aims to provide housing for the Economically Weaker Sections of people who do not own a pucca house. Through this scheme, dwelling units are provided to poor people in rural and urban areas, and those affected by calamities or government projects.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  --- [Sub-Schema 131] ---
  Title: Pratyasha Scheme- West Bengal
  Link:  https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/ps-west-bengal
  Description:
    The Government of West Bengal has undertaken a housing project scheme named ” PRATYASHA” for Police Personnel (from Inspectors to Constables) working in the West Bengal Police to materialize their dreams of owning houses.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
